judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is functionally sound and satisfies every acceptance criterion in the issue, including summing usage across multiple tool rounds, handling rounds with omitted usage without producing NaN/undefined, and leaving single-round behavior unchanged. To make the hook signature unambiguous, the candidate introduces an `AggregateUsageMetadata` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts` (specifically mentioned in the ticket's key files), whereas the reference simply renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate updated the line in the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section rather than moving it up to the main requirements section and updating `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md` as the reference did. The candidate also added a separate acceptance test file and `.lore/dod.md` artifact alongside the unit test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
